testdescription: Control point: after ordinary structural projection, invoke explicit production backfill with external credentials for pre-existing Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View records; interrupt a bounded batch, inject isolated record failure, resume, and rerun. Observation point: all three channels are independently enumerated and complete; stable canonical identity and canonical/content/index/provider/model/version/dimensions/vector metadata are persisted; checkpoints, retries, and isolated failures are visible; resume does not restart completed work; rerun is idempotent; no fake canonical mutation occurs; and alignment waits for all channels.

Control point: use the separate production persistence path to backfill all three channels, restart, update one canonical object, tombstone another, and run unrelated live-E2E runId cleanup. Observation point: unchanged stable-identity vectors and complete canonical/content/index/provider/model/version/dimensions/vector metadata survive restart and test-only cleanup; the changed record is upserted and version-aligned; the tombstone is deleted; no production runId cleanup occurs; canonical JSON remains authoritative; and Neo4j remains projection/index only.
